digest.component_or_area: outbound parent sync (CREATE and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit path (_map_local_to_jira_fields:145-156) silently drops a bound non-epic parent with only logger.debug, no durable bridge_alerts record
ACLI attach fallback (_attach_parent_guarded:136-143) swallows HTTP 400 from set_parent with WARNING only, never calling record_parent_divergence

The 8b25 non-epic parent guard is unconditional but documented as Cloud-specific; on Data Center it suppresses a write that would be silently accept-and-ignored, and the doc/code divergence should be resolved
UPDATE emit path already holds the rule (fixed by 9f26); the four outbound parent surfaces must all record dropped/rejected parents durably to bridge_alerts, not via log lines
An unbound parent must remain silent on a CREATE because it converges on later passes; alerting on it is churn
